items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: A young man had been hired by Basie by the name of [sounds like] Ray Pirello.

ctx.x: Who did you follow into, I mean who was the drummer before you?

Well it’s an interesting story. A young man had been hired by Basie by the name of [sounds like] Ray Pirello. And he’d just been with the band a few weeks when he was in a very bad car accident in Chicago and wound up in the hospital. And Basic called me to come fill in, which I did. Originally I think it was one of these week to ten day things, until Ray was better. But his injuries were more extensive than anybody thought.
